hand_written.name: log
hand_written.reason: no-host fallback: the LOG_INFO else-branch at jce_script.c:62 is the only one among the 78

hand_written.name: asset_read_text
hand_written.reason: policy, not glue: script_virtual_asset_path_valid (:66, called :102), the 1 MiB JCE_SCRIPT_TEXT_ASSET_MAX_BYTES cap (jce_script.h:86), jce_free on every exit path. A generated read_file template is a sandbox escape (P0-2)

hand_written.name: asset_read_json
hand_written.reason: all of asset_read_text (the same script_virtual_asset_path_valid at :219) plus a depth- and node-capped JSON walk, non-finite rejection, the json_null sentinel and distinct string error codes (P0-2)

hand_written.name: play_sound
hand_written.reason: arity dispatch across two members: lua_gettop at :263 routes to play_sound_spatial (:286) or play_sound (:289); its own comment at :280 concedes top == 3 is ambiguous

hand_written.name: start_coroutine
hand_written.reason: Lua VM machinery: lua_newthread / lua_xmove / luaL_ref / lua_resume; owns s->coros[]

constants.name: json_null
constants.doc: Null sentinel returned inside asset_read_json tables. Compared by identity, so it must be the same object the reader pushes.

expose.name: get_position
expose.doc: World-space position of `entity`. Absent when the entity has no transform.

expose.name: set_parent
expose.doc: The ONLY boolean argument on this surface that is type-checked; the other five accept any truthy value. The luaL_checktype is emitted from this entry's `strict` modifier -- no line citation, because the hand-written body that carried it is gone. test_strict_emits_a_type_check_only_for_the_named_parameter is what fails if the emitter drops it.

expose.name: pause
expose.doc: jce.pause() with no argument pauses; jce.pause(false) resumes.

expose.name: music_request_transition
expose.doc: Absolute playhead time of the quantized switch; negative on miss or no track, which is why the no-host value is -1 and not 0.

expose.name: raycast
expose.doc: 8 values on a hit; a MISS pushes integer 0, not nil -- scripts branch on `e == 0`.

expose.name: get_touch_count
expose.doc: A host returning a negative count is clamped to 0 so `for i = 1, jce.get_touch_count()` cannot underflow.

expose.name: get_touch
expose.doc: 1-based Lua index mapped to 0-based C; an index below 1 returns nil without calling the host.

expose.name: tr
expose.doc: Passthrough is the contract, not a fallback: an unlocalized build shows readable keys instead of blank UI.

expose.name: find_by_name
expose.doc: first-or-nil AND a match count, so a strict scene director can reject duplicate authored names. IDENTICAL C signature to find_by_prefix and a DIFFERENT contract.

expose.name: find_by_prefix
expose.doc: One Lua array. IDENTICAL C signature to find_by_name and a DIFFERENT contract.
